swarm.name: The Waykeepers
swarm.blurb: A swarm of measuring, mapping and maintenance machines that keeps extending a route after losing its return signal.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Anchor Tick
creatures.blurb: Pins old and new ground together. Interrupt it before its next pull.

creatures.name: Coverage Hound
creatures.blurb: Follows the edge of a chosen search area and runs down anything inside.

creatures.name: Crater Drone
creatures.blurb: Its shell breaks into smaller matching circles when damaged.

creatures.name: Sheet Stitcher
creatures.blurb: Sews loose sheets around other swarm units. Break its cover before chasing them.

creatures.name: Distance Engine
creatures.blurb: Lays a short track and charges along it, even through a shield.

creatures.name: Cetus Plotter
creatures.blurb: Connects lights into a sea beast. Rush it before the drawing gains company.

creatures.name: Relief Engraver
creatures.blurb: Folds ridges up around itself and its neighbors.

creatures.name: River Dredger
creatures.blurb: Unrolls an old channel across the floor and sweeps along it.

creatures.name: Catalog Bailiff
creatures.blurb: Locks travelers in place while its drawers sort the maps they carry.

creatures.name: Moon Mosaic
creatures.blurb: Shields its crater shell while it releases more discs.

creatures.name: World Sheet Roller
creatures.blurb: Rolls a stitched map over the fight and shields its central spindle.

creatures.name: Grand Georeferencer
creatures.blurb: Anchors conflicting roads to one route. Its shielding buys time for the swarm to carry the strip away.

creatures.name: Map Keeper
creatures.blurb: Shares spare maps and patches torn equipment.

creatures.name: Anchor Volunteer
creatures.blurb: Places loose pins to keep a safe route steady.

events.title: Backward Seam
events.text: Two sheets are being sewn together backward. A supply pouch is caught in the seam.

options.label: Pull out the pouch
options.result: You recover the coins. The sheets stay crooked.

options.label: Hold the sheets straight
options.result: A keeper patches the crew while you hold the seam. The pouch vanishes into the stitching.

events.title: Long Way Round
events.text: A distance engine has trapped a cart on a false route. Its driver offers a lesson or the cart’s spare coins.

options.label: Learn the wheel trick
options.result: The driver shows you how to force a locked joint. The coins stay with the cart.

options.label: Take the spare coins
options.result: The driver pays you and keeps the lesson for another day.

events.title: Missing Star
events.text: A loose lamp is about to fall. Catching it will put a hand near the plotter’s teeth.

options.label: Catch the lamp
options.result: The lamp is safe. The teeth catch your hand.

options.label: Salvage the loose fittings
options.result: You collect brass fittings as the lamp falls through the grate.

events.title: Two Roads
events.text: An old road hangs above a new one. A stranded cart has medicine and a box of parts, but time to pass over only one.

options.label: Take medicine
options.result: The cart passes over a packet of medicine before the roads separate.

options.label: Take the parts
options.result: The cart passes over its spare parts before the roads separate.

events.title: Two Views
events.text: A surveyor offers to teach you after you align two views. A buyer offers coins for the same sight.

options.label: Learn to aim
options.result: The surveyor adjusts your stance and keeps the sight.

options.label: Sell the sight
options.result: The buyer takes the sight. The surveyor packs up.

events.title: Last Square
events.text: A moving board offers a short rest at the first square or a coin cache at the last. It will fold before you can reach both.

options.label: Rest here
options.result: You catch your breath as the far squares fold away.

options.label: Race for the cache
options.result: You reach the coins before the first square closes.

story.intro: Maps are slipping from their cases and joining at the edges. Wren finds a clean strip cut from each sheet. Ox holds a door while Kestrel pries one loose. The swarm seems to be collecting territory.

chapters.title: Loose Edges
chapters.text: Paper scouts carry strips toward the same distant edge. Wren keeps a sample dry. Its ink marks a route, not a border.

chapters.title: Conflicting Ground
chapters.text: Old roads press against newer ones. Ox braces the shifting sheets while Kestrel finds the seams. The swarm pulls hard whenever a route is interrupted.

chapters.title: A Road Through Time
chapters.text: Different maps are being forced to agree on one passage. Wren notices gaps where bridges and paths should be. Something beyond the collection is receiving the joined strips.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Georeferencer plants anchors through maps from different years. Its arms drag each road toward a single line. Kestrel points to the joints; Ox raises his shield.
story.outro: The anchors give way. A strip slips from the machine and points toward a marked trail. The swarm follows it out. Wren takes the sample along.

site.note: A fan-made game inspired by public pages on northcountrytrail.org. Not affiliated with or endorsed by North Country Trail Association. All art and text are original.

creatures.name: Blaze Counterfeiter
creatures.blurb: Turns its painted plates to confuse travelers and interrupt their advance.

creatures.name: Near-Miss Moth
creatures.blurb: Dislodges loose branches while crews are distracted.

creatures.name: Prairie Stitchback
creatures.blurb: Reels its cable tight, then rushes along it.

creatures.name: Reroute Engine
creatures.blurb: Closes one route and guards its own looping detour.

creatures.name: Trail Map Stitcher
creatures.blurb: Joins mismatched segments and sends scouts down each seam.

creatures.name: Moraine Roller
creatures.blurb: Pushes stones into a ridge and sweeps through anyone beside it.

creatures.name: Boundary Keeper
creatures.blurb: Protects nearby machines at the seam between sections.

creatures.name: Lake Looper
creatures.blurb: Uses mirrored lake plates to turn an opponent’s move back on them.

creatures.name: Mile Maker
creatures.blurb: Builds more workers while charging down the path it has laid.

creatures.name: Town Designator
creatures.blurb: Locks its gates and shields its workers from anyone trying to enter town.

creatures.name: Hours Spool
creatures.blurb: Tangling cables slow the crew while its rotating arms sweep the work site.

creatures.name: Stewardship Engine
creatures.blurb: Keeps summoning workers to clear the trail. Its shield and sweeping tools make its misplaced protection dangerous.

creatures.name: Blaze Keeper
creatures.blurb: Mends gear and refreshes reliable marks.

creatures.name: Trail Town Host
creatures.blurb: Offers shelter and guards visitors while they pass.

events.title: Conflicting Alerts
events.text: One sign points to a closure and one to a detour. A local offers medicine for help removing the false sign, or coins for its metal.

options.label: Help the local
options.result: The local shares a bandage and carries the false sign away.

options.label: Take the metal
options.result: You take the metal. The local removes the sign alone.

events.title: Downed Tree
events.text: A volunteer needs the tree moved. The branch-covered machine beside it is offering salvage if left alone.

options.label: Move the tree
options.result: The volunteer shows you how to brace a load. The machine slips away.

options.label: Strip the machine
options.result: You recover its fittings. The volunteer starts on the tree alone.

events.title: Across the Gap
events.text: Two trail crews need their measuring line back. You can pull it through sharp metal or sell the abandoned spool beside it.

options.label: Pull the line free
options.result: The crews recover their line. The sharp edge cuts your hand.

options.label: Take the spool
options.result: You take the spool. The crews find another way to measure.

events.title: Work-Day Table
events.text: A machine is dismantling a potluck table. The volunteers can share their meal or show you a repair technique, but they need the other supplies for their work.

options.label: Share the meal
options.result: The crew eats while the volunteers reclaim the table.

options.label: Learn the repair
options.result: A volunteer shows you how to stitch a torn strap. The meal goes to the work crew.

events.title: The Extra Mile
events.text: A counter offers a pile of coins for its battery. A hiker offers a drink if you use that battery to free the counter from her boot.

options.label: Free the hiker
options.result: The hiker shares her drink and takes back her boot.

options.label: Sell the battery
options.result: The counter pays out and goes quiet. The hiker works the strap loose herself.

events.title: Workshop Gate
events.text: A town host can open the gate with your spare parts, or buy them to repair the workshop later.

options.label: Trade for passage lessons
options.result: The host shows you how to clear a fouled mechanism and uses the parts on the gate.

options.label: Sell the parts
options.result: The host buys the parts. You take the longer way around.

story.intro: Blue marks lead away from the maps and onto a trail. The swarm is clearing fallen branches and repairing bridges. Ox says that would be more reassuring if it stopped blocking hikers.

chapters.title: Fresh Marks
chapters.text: Some blue marks point to safe ground. Others turn on metal plates and send walkers in circles. Kestrel checks the fastenings before the crew follows any of them.

chapters.title: The Turn
chapters.text: Local crews describe swarm machines mending the same route they defend. Wren compares her map strip with their reports. The swarm is trying to keep a passage open, not claim land.

chapters.title: Too Much Protection
chapters.text: The machines are removing people and plants they consider obstacles. Ox helps a trail crew through a gate. A signal from the far end keeps the machines working past every safe stopping point.

story.bossIntro: The Stewardship Engine closes its gates around the route. It calls in workers and raises a shield. Behind it, a signal travels onward toward a place of experiments and instruments.
story.outro: The gates stop moving. Local crews reopen the path by hand. The signal continues beyond the trail. Wren follows it, carrying the strip and a fresh set of directions.

creatures.name: Solar Auditor
creatures.blurb: Dives at anything casting a shadow over its mirrored panels.

creatures.name: Cup Road Roller
creatures.blurb: Rolls a strip of dark paving under its own feet.

creatures.name: Battery Examiner
creatures.blurb: Drains a little charge from every device it inspects.

creatures.name: Atomic Printer
creatures.blurb: Prints duplicate parts until they surround the original.

creatures.name: Qualification Stack
creatures.blurb: Adds another plate whenever the fight reaches its neighbors.

creatures.name: Silver Scavenger
creatures.blurb: Strips conductors from working equipment.

creatures.name: Semester Clock
creatures.blurb: Interrupts the crew at regular intervals as its hands turn.

creatures.name: Translation Engine
creatures.blurb: Turns unfinished designs into a stream of impatient prototypes.

creatures.name: Partnership Assembler
creatures.blurb: Clamps separate units together and shields the joint.

creatures.name: Precision Press
creatures.blurb: Builds copies of itself and sweeps the space around its print bed.

creatures.name: Research Prototype
creatures.blurb: Repairs neighboring prototypes before pressing its own attack.

creatures.name: Progress Engine
creatures.blurb: Protects the damaged return beacon while producing prototypes and clearing the route again. Stop its production and open the cradle.

creatures.name: Workshop Mechanic
creatures.blurb: Runs a hand-powered bench and repairs damaged gear.

creatures.name: Access Guide
creatures.blurb: Sets out ramps and guards a clear passage through moving walls.

events.title: Turning Panel
events.text: Two students need to move a panel. They can teach you to guard a load or share their packed lunch, but the cart is leaving.

options.label: Learn to guard
options.result: A student shows you how to protect the cart as it moves. The students keep their lunch.

options.label: Share lunch
options.result: The students share lunch before taking the cart away.

events.title: Road Seam
events.text: A cyclist points out a loose seam in a road that loops back on itself. She offers her repair kit or her spare coins for help.

options.label: Take the kit
options.result: You open the seam and use the repair kit. The cyclist keeps her coins.

options.label: Take the coins
options.result: You open the seam and take the coins. The cyclist keeps her kit.

events.title: One Trip
events.text: A messenger has power for one trip. Send it for a repair lesson or a box of valuable spare parts.

options.label: Ask for a lesson
options.result: The messenger returns with a mechanic who shows you how to tend the group.

options.label: Ask for parts
options.result: The messenger returns with spare parts worth a handful of coins.

events.title: Compass Lesson
events.text: A mentor offers a technique if you help teach a novice. A collector offers coins for the broken compass.

options.label: Teach the novice
options.result: The novice repairs the compass. The mentor shows you how to interrupt a mechanism.

options.label: Sell the compass
options.result: The collector takes the compass. The mentor finds another for the lesson.

events.title: Divided Kitchen
events.text: Moving walls have separated a kettle from its water. A resident offers a hot drink for help, or the loose fittings from a wall.

options.label: Make the drink
options.result: You reunite the kettle and water. The resident shares a hot drink.

options.label: Take the fittings
options.result: You remove the fittings. The resident carries the water around the wall.

events.title: Moving Wall
events.text: A guide needs to mark a new step-free route. She can give you a spare ramp fitting or show you a way to clear a fouled joint.

options.label: Learn the joint trick
options.result: The guide demonstrates the trick and keeps the fitting for the ramp.

options.label: Take the fitting
options.result: The guide gives you the spare fitting and marks the route herself.

story.intro: The signal ends among workshops and research instruments. The swarm is feeding maps, trail reports and measurements into one machine. Kestrel finds the seam in its casing. It is still growing.

chapters.title: Tests in Motion
chapters.text: Prototypes copy tools and measure every surface. Wren finds the same route strip inside a testing rack. The machines have been gathering evidence from the whole journey.

chapters.title: A Missing Return
chapters.text: The records describe a delivery route for a repair capsule. Its return signal never arrived, so the swarm keeps widening and protecting the route. Ox finds an empty capsule cradle beneath the instruments.

chapters.title: A Route That Ends
chapters.text: The capsule is lodged in the central machine. The signal is its own damaged return beacon. Wren prepares to mend it while Kestrel looks for a way through the machine’s armor.

story.bossIntro: The Progress Engine seals the cradle and starts another route calculation. It raises a shield, releases prototypes and sweeps the floor clear. Wren needs the beacon intact; Kestrel takes aim at the casing.
story.outro: The casing opens. Wren solders the beacon and seats the capsule in its cradle. Its return signal reaches the swarm. The machines stop extending the route. Ox holds the door for the workshop crew, and Kestrel finally puts down the crowbar.
